```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(doParallel)
library(patchwork)
#library(DHARMa) 
library(afex)
```

```{r load data}
Neuroethics_Judgement <- read.csv(here::here("data", "Cleaned_Pilot", "clean_data_longV2.csv"), stringsAsFactors=TRUE) %>% 
  select(user_id, condition, risk, gain, no_effect, experimental_treatment_selected, Yes, No, age, sex, Income, education, race_ethnicity) %>% 
   mutate(experimental_treatment_selected = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0), trials = Yes + No)-> data

continuous <- c("risk", "gain","no_effect", "age")

#within subject scaling
data <- data %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  mutate(risk = scale(risk),
         gain = scale(gain)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
p1 <- data %>% ggplot(aes(risk, fill = condition)) + geom_histogram(bins = 8, color  = "black",  fill="#ee7c2e") + theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~ experimental_treatment_selected)
  
p2 <- data %>% ggplot(aes(gain)) + geom_histogram(bins = 9, color  = "black", fill="#4673c3") + theme_minimal()+  facet_wrap(~experimental_treatment_selected)
p1 + p2

data %>% ggplot(aes(risk, fill = condition)) + geom_density(color  = "black",  fill="#ee7c2e") + theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~ experimental_treatment_selected)
data %>% ggplot(aes(gain, fill = condition)) + geom_density(color  = "black",  fill="#4673c3") + theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~ experimental_treatment_selected)
```

```{r build model}
# doParallel::registerDoParallel() #use parallel processing
#start with risk, and gain
cl <- makeCluster(4)
clusterEvalQ(cl, require(lme4))
m.1 <- glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ 1 + risk + gain +
               I(risk^2) + I(gain^2) +
                risk:gain +
                risk:I(gain^2) +
                gain:I(risk^2) +
               I(gain^2):I(risk^2) +
             (1 + risk + gain | user_id), 
             data = data, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 0)
stopCluster(cl)

se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m.1)))
# table of estimates with 95% CI
(tab <- cbind(Est = fixef(m.1), LL = fixef(m.1) - 1.96 * se, UL = fixef(m.1) + 1.96 * se))
exp(tab)
summary(m.1)
broomExtra::glance(m.1)
broomExtra::augment(m.1)
broomExtra::tidy(m.1)
ranef(m.1)
fixef(m.1)
getME(m.1, "theta")
```

```{r simulate data}
sampler <- function(dat, clustervar, replace = TRUE, reps = 1) {
    cid <- unique(dat[, clustervar[1]])
    ncid <- length(cid)
    recid <- sample(cid, size = ncid * reps, replace = TRUE)
    if (replace) {
        rid <- lapply(seq_along(recid), function(i) {
            cbind(NewID = i, RowID = sample(which(dat[, clustervar] == recid[i]),
                size = length(which(dat[, clustervar] == recid[i])), replace = TRUE))
        })
    } else {
        rid <- lapply(seq_along(recid), function(i) {
            cbind(NewID = i, RowID = which(dat[, clustervar] == recid[i]))
        })
    }
    dat <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, rid))
    dat$Replicate <- factor(cut(dat$NewID, breaks = c(1, ncid * 1:reps), include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = FALSE))
    dat$NewID <- factor(dat$NewID)
    return(dat)
}
cl <- makeCluster(4)
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl) #use parallel processing

set.seed(20)
tmp <- sampler(data, "user_id", reps = 1000)
bigdata <- cbind(tmp, data[tmp$RowID, ])
doParallel::stopImplicitCluster(cl)
```


```{r set specifications}
f <- fixef(m.1)
r <- getME(m.1, "theta")

cl <- makeCluster(4)
clusterExport(cl, c("bigdata", "f", "r"))
clusterEvalQ(cl, require(lme4))
```

```{r bootstrap}
myboot <- function(i) {
    object <- try(glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ 1 + cor_pearson + risk + gain  + I(risk^2) + I(gain^2) +
                risk:gain +
                risk:I(gain^2) +
                gain:I(risk^2) + 
             (1 + risk + gain + I(risk^2) + I(gain^2)| user_id), 
             data = bigdata, subset = Replicate == i, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 1, start = list(fixef = f, theta = r)), silent = TRUE)
    if (class(object) == "try-error")
        return(object)
    c(fixef(object), getME(object, "theta"))
}
```

```{r}
start <- proc.time()
res <- parLapplyLB(cl, X = levels(bigdata$Replicate), fun = myboot)
end <- proc.time()

# shut down the cluster
stopCluster(cl)
```

```{r}
# calculate proportion of models that successfully converged
success <- sapply(res, is.numeric)
mean(success)
```

```{r}
# combine successful results
bigres <- do.call(cbind, res[success])

# calculate 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles for 95% CI
(ci <- t(apply(bigres, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))))

# All results
finaltable <- cbind(Est = c(f, r), SE = c(se, NA), BootMean = rowMeans(bigres),
    ci)
# round and print
round(finaltable, 3)
```
